name: Kimisaki Hiromi
source:
She is an office lady in the sales department.
Although she is very guarded around men, she is not used to romance and is easily deceived by bad men. She has a tendency to get very anxious, so be careful when dealing with her.
For some reason, she seems to like yakisoba noodles.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040429210739/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/kisaku/kisaku4.html]game's site, archived[/url]]
